description: Tab — a ghost selectable with a bottom border. md squared (Curtis: a tab is squared where a button is squished), so heights resolve to 32 / 44 / 52 across densities. Resting: transparent fill, subtle text, subtle underline. Selected: accent text and accent-medium underline — state, not affordance: no selected-hover (why re-click a selected tab?), but it stays focusable (the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern puts roving tabindex on the selected tab).
notes: Colour pairings verified against the EDS Core colour usage file (node 8349:2422). The file's hover used bg-fill-muted-default because the ghost ladder did not exist yet — fill-ghost-hover is the same palette step, properly named. The file's disabled used an opacity variable (Interaction/Disabled); this contract uses disabled tokens instead, per our system and ADR-0016. Resting text is subtle per the usage file. v0.2.0 (2026-08-30, review walk): label md -> lg — the original tab is 16px (comfortable), compressed, in the md-squared box; heights re-derive to 36/44/52. The team’s new 14px tab is a redesign we do not follow (their added badge is a good call for product needs — credit where due — but out of scope here). Resting text stays SUBTLE, confirmed: tabs are navigation, not content — you navigate, you are there; they must not get in the way.

aria.aria-selected: the selected state; carried as [aria-selected] in CSS, lowered to the State=Selected variant in Figma
